entities.name: Carl Gustaf Ekeberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Gustaf Ekeberg was a Swedish physician, chemist and explorer. He made several voyages to the East Indies and China as a sea captain. He brought back reports of the tea tree and wrote a number of books.
